svg.title: Threat budget versus income, waves 1 to 160
svg.desc: Log-scale line chart. B(w) rises from 20 to 1.2e19; cumulative income reaches 3.2M by wave 160; maximum passive income falls with c(w) after wave 50.
svg.text: Threat grows past every income source after the surge
Credits or mass per wave, log scale. Pop income assumes every shell of the wave is destroyed.
wave 90: one wave outweighs all income ever earned
